Hello I am Abhishek Verma

Final year Btech Student

Connect with me

I’m Abhishek Verma, a Computer Science Engineering student passionate about building scalable web applications and solving real-world problems with clean, efficient code. Currently, I’m deepening my expertise in Java Full Stack Development (Spring Boot, React, REST APIs, and databases), while also exploring data analytics and visualization with Tableau. I have hands-on experience with React, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, and Java, and I’ve built projects ranging from doctor appointment systems to e-commerce dashboards. I’m also preparing for industry placements, sharpening my skills in DSA, problem-solving, and full-stack development best practices. Beyond tech, I’m an anime enthusiast and empath who enjoys creative storytelling and thoughtful design—traits I bring into my coding projects.
